Hand cream: permitted.
21 CFR 74.2707a(b) states: "D&C Yellow No. 7 may be safely used for coloring externally applied cosmetics in amounts consistent with good manufacturing practice." [2].
Use limit: no percentage is stated; the amount is consistent with good manufacturing practice [2].
21 CFR 74.2707a(a) states: "The color additive Ext. D&C Yellow No. 7 shall conform in identity and specifications to the requirements of § 74.1707a (a)(1) and (b)." [1].
21 CFR 74.2707a(c) states: "The label of the color additive shall conform to the requirements of § 70.25 of this chapter." [3].
21 CFR 74.2707a(d) states: "All batches of Ext. D&C Yellow No. 7 shall be certified in accordance with regulations in part 80 of this chapter." [4].
21 CFR 82.2707a states: "The color additive Ext. D&C Yellow No. 7 shall conform in identity with specifications to the requirements of § 74.1707a(a)(1) and (b) of this chapter. Ext. D&C Yellow No. 7 is restricted to use in externally applied drugs and cosmetics." [5].
21 CFR 70.3(v) states: "The terms externally applied drugs and externally applied cosmetics mean drugs or cosmetics applied only to external parts of the body and not to the lips or any body surface covered by mucous membrane." [6].
21 CFR 82.2050 states: "A batch of a straight color listed in this subpart may be certified, in accordance with the provisions of this part, for use in externally applied drugs and cosmetics, if such batch conforms to the requirements of § 82.5 and to the specifications set forth in this subpart for such color." [7].
